narrative_purpose: Show the atmospheric penalty directly: identical fuel burning in two different airs, one flame tall and bright, the other squat and dull, so the reader sees that the diluent gas alone changes the fire.
subject: Two identical small bundles of dry twigs, each about a hand's length, standing upright side by side with a wide dark gap between them, each burning. The bundle on the LEFT carries a tall narrow bright flame reaching well above it, pale yellow-white at its base rising to warm orange, with a clean pointed tip. The bundle on the RIGHT carries a flame less than half that height, wide and rounded and squat, a duller deep orange with a murky core and no bright base at all.
scene: A plain dark stone slab surface running across the lower third of the frame, everything behind falling into flat void-indigo darkness with faint haze; no other objects in the frame.
camera: Straight-on eye-level view, both flames at the same scale and the same distance, symmetrically placed.
light: Each flame lights only itself and a small pool of the stone beneath it; the left flame throws a noticeably larger and brighter pool than the right; the space between and behind them stays dark.
palette: Deep void-indigo darkness dominant; the left flame pale amber to warm orange, the right flame a duller muddier orange; cool grey stone beneath.
style: Painterly naturalist comparison plate, two specimens presented side by side for study, restrained and diagrammatic in arrangement but painted, not graphic.
detail_level: High on both flames and their fuel bundles; the surrounding darkness deliberately empty and low-detail.
composition: Two-panel feel achieved by placement alone with no drawn divider: left bundle at one third, right bundle at two thirds, a broad column of plain dark space between them and dark empty space above the shorter flame.
consistency_notes: The two fuel bundles must look IDENTICAL — same size, same twigs, same arrangement. Only the flames differ: left tall narrow bright, right short wide dull. No divider drawn between the halves. Cool dark surroundings with the flames as the only warm elements.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no dividing line or panel border, no arrows, no measuring instruments, no green vegetation, no 3D-render or photographic look, no cartoon style
